{{Top|leg}}
'''Electric prods''' were generally cylindrical devices that delivered an electric charge, that could be used to force a being or creature into submission. [[Sabotage droid/Legends|Sabotage droid]]s had electrical prods as part of their arsenal and electric prods were also bolted on the side of the [[Tirrith restraining globe]] to keep [[Mils Giel]]'s mutated [[Tirrith]] agitated and at bay. The prod was powered by a [[Vuvritech 44 generator]].
